text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=hosted-inference-high-latency | incident=PD-89213 | policy=prod-latency -> triggered. Primary on-call: maria (oncall). Escalation in 2m if unacknowledged. https://pagerduty.example/PD-89213

maria (oncall): on it, grabbing logs. can folks avoid deploys for next 10m?

raj (sre): checking metrics — p95 token latency up 4x for inference-hosted-01, errors increase on cpu fallback. I see KV cache miss storms. looking at routing.

incidentbot: PagerDuty escalated to secondary: raj (sre) — no ack from primary within 2m.

raj (sre): acked. taking ownership. repro steps: hitting prod with synthetic load showed steady latency increase after ~8:45 UTC.

kevin (infra): noticing node reboot churn on gpu-pool-3 around the same window. suspicious. rolling restart completed 8:53 but traffic still high. tagging host IDs: `i-0a1b2c3d4e` `i-0f9e8d7c6b`.

sophie (support): customers pinging support — a handful of slow responses across apps, some timeouts. open ticket ENG-5276. sending status update to affected customers now.

raj (sre): mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic to fallback-region (eu-west) for low-priority routes 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 instances 3) enable aggressive prefix caching for legacy routes. executing now.

maria (oncall): +1 on divert. please announce throttle to console routes so product knows.

kevin (infra): running command to scale:

```
redwood infra scale gpu-pool-3 --add 2 --region us-east-1
```
will follow up when nodes join.

raj (sre): enabled prefix cache patch on canary model group:

```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/models/cache/enable -d '{"group":"canary","ttl":120}'
```
canary shows 30% lower latency already. deploying to prod shortly.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: secondary check-in required in 5m.

sophie (support): update sent to customers: "We're aware of elevated latency affecting inference endpoints. We're mitigating and will update in 10 minutes."

maria (oncall): timeline note: incident created at 3301112222. brief summary added to channel.

raj (sre): traffic divert started at ~3301112260. observations: p95 improved from 950ms -> 420ms on diverted traffic; original region still heavy but scaling nodes are initializing.

kevin (infra): new nodes `i-0z9y8x7w6v` and `i-0q1w2e3r4t` joined at 3301112280. autoscaler logs show GPU warmup pending.

incidentbot: PagerDuty attempted manager escalation (jordan (manager)) due to repeated secondary check-in reminder.

jordan (manager): on the bridge. do we need to spin up a hot standby or fail traffic permanently? what's RTO here?

raj (sre): not yet necessary to fail permanently. RTO target < 15m. current plan: validate new nodes + propagate cache patch to prod model groups. if no improvement, we will failover heavy customers to dedicated lanes.

maria (oncall): also checking if recent deploy touched KV config — rolling back last deploy would be fast if needed. last deploy id: `deploy-2026-03-15-0844`.

kevin (infra): deploy did include small KV client change. patch revert is ready: `revert/deploy-2026-03-15-0844`. standby to run revert if patch doesn't help.

raj (sre): prod cache rollout in progress. applying to 80% of model groups now.

sophie (support): customers acknowledge status update. several asked for ETA — replying "targeting under 20 minutes, will update sooner".

incidentbot: PagerDuty: secondary check-in overdue. Escalation to manager (jordan (manager)) completed.

maria (oncall): handoff to raj — I need to step away for a quick on-call refresh, will be reachable.

raj (sre): acknowledged handoff. coordination notes: if latency persists after cache rollout, run `kv-compact` on the busiest cache shards: `./tools/kv-compact --shard s12 --dry-run` then execute.

kevin (infra): nodes healthy and accepting traffic. small increase in GPU utilization typical during warmup.

raj (sre): after full rollout, p95 in primary region down to 310ms. failures also dropped. I recommend we keep extra 2 nodes for 1 hour, monitor.

jordan (manager): agree. keep scaling for now and schedule a short post-incident review after service stabilizes. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sophie (support): sending final customer update: "Issue mitigated, latency reduced. We are monitoring and will follow up with root cause once confirmed."

maria (oncall): closing PD incident in case timeline needs it — I'll leave a note in PD about manual manager escalation and check-in race.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: incident PD-89213 status changed to RESOLVED by maria (oncall).

raj (sre): quick followups: 1) postmortem to include KV client change + node churn correlation 2) add an automated pre-check to block canary KV client deploys if GPU-pool drain rate > 0.05 3) add sticky-routing fallback when cache miss rate > 0.15.

jordan (manager): please capture action items and owners. moving to postmortem board.

sophie (support): thanks all — will update support tickets and close once postmortem link is available.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone, great cross-team response.

---
Note: timeline and timestamps are approximate. This thread contains automated PD transitions: primary->secondary ack, secondary check-in reminders, manager escalation.
